summary: Columbia Financial, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the commencement of a second-step conversion of its mutual holding company (MHC) to a stock holding company form, effectively going-private as the mutual structure is eliminated. The newly formed Maryland corporation, Columbia Financial, Inc., will offer up to 192,625,000 shares at $10.00 per share on a best-efforts basis to eligible depositors. Concurrently, conditional regulatory approval from the Federal Reserve and OCC has been obtained to acquire Northfield Bancorp, Inc. immediately post-conversion. The filing includes terms of the subscription offering and regulatory milestones, with the offering expected to begin on May 21, 2026. Watch for subscription period results and completion of the conversion and acquisition.
